basics.name: Nabeel Soudagar
basics.label: Full Stack Developer | Web & Cross-Platform Mobile
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer with 2+ years of experience designing, building, and deploying scalable web and mobile applications using React.js, React Native, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, and Supabase. Track record of delivering paid, production-grade solutions for corporate clients, including a full-stack platform for Infinity Group. Currently building cross-platform mobile features at Turtu, with additional experience across AI-powered image analysis, telemedicine, and business-management platforms.

work.summary: Developed and shipped 6+ production features for cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, supporting active end users across iOS and Android. Architected reusable UI components and centralized state management, cutting feature delivery time by 15% under Agile/Scrum sprint cycles. Implemented secure REST APIs with JWT authentication and integrated CI/CD pipelines, enabling weekly production deployments with zero downtime. Partnered with cross-functional teams to debug and optimize application performance, resolving 20+ production issues and improving app responsiveness.

Built and maintained web application features end-to-end using modern frontend and backend technologies. Implemented RESTful APIs and optimized SQL queries, reducing API response time by 20% and improving overall application performance. Collaborated with engineering teams on Test-Driven Development (TDD), debugging, and deployment workflows in production IT environments.
